title: Quick chickpea braise with kale and harissa

source.title: Quick chickpea braise with kale and harissa

ingredients.name: Preserved lemon
ingredients.amount: 1, or the zest of an unwaxed lemon

instructions: Thinly slice the onion and garlic. Roughly chop the kale leaves and shred the stems, keeping them separate. Halve the preserved lemon, discard the flesh and finely chop the peel. Roughly chop the parsley.
Put a little oil in a large frying pan, add the onion and cook over a medium heat for 5 minutes. Add the garlic, kale stems and turmeric and cook for a couple of minutes.
Add the preserved lemon peel, the tomatoes and the chickpeas with their liquid (plus 150ml water if using jarred chickpeas). Cook for about 10 minutes, until thickened and reduced.
Add the kale leaves and cook for a few minutes until wilted. Taste and season, then stir in most of the parsley.
Ripple the yoghurt and harissa together and serve with the braise, a drizzle of tahini, the rest of the parsley and warm flatbreads.
